species.name: Crappie
why: Water 58°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 4–18 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Largemouth bass
why: Water 58°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 1–18 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
East wind at 10 mph pushes bait onto the west shore: try the wind-blown banks.
